title: Catalogue listing (sidecar to a menu)
description: Catalogue-only details about one menu. Lives beside it as <menuId>.listing.json. The menu file itself is unchanged and is exactly what the plugin loads. Written by the author; build-time facts (hash, size, features) are computed, never written here.

menuId.description: Must equal the menuId of the menu file beside it (lower-case).

title.description: The film or series name as shown on the site. Authoritative: the site never looks titles up elsewhere.

description.description: One or two plain sentences about the menu's look. No markup.

licence.description: Every menu in the catalogue is dedicated to the public domain.

github.description: GitHub username, if the author wants to be credited with a link.

artSources.description: Where any artwork the menu refers to comes from, or the single word "none" if it refers to none. A menu that refers to asset: files must say where they come from.

changelog.description: What changed in each revision after the first.

demo.description: True for sample menus made to show off the format. The site hides them by default, because they are for real titles.
